title: A Computationally Efficient and Human Implementable Minimum-lap-time Control Policy for Energy-limited Race Cars
summary: This paper presents a provably optimal, real-time capable energy management policy for race cars that provides simple human-driver-implementable control cues. Specifically, we first formulate the energy-constrained minimum-lap-time control problem via Pontryagin's Minimum Principle (PMP) and derive the optimal policy and costate dynamics using Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) optimality conditions.
